{{Quote|The only reason I stayed is because an Imperial officer recognized me. Called me by my old name. Said the "Emperor's Wrath" is coming.|Sajar|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
An '''officer''' was part of an [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] force sent to capture the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Adrenal Research Base]] on [[Quesh]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Quesh war|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> around [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sajar]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] the corpses of Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] at the Imperials gathered outside of the facility, the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] recognized the Jedi as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sajar, a former member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. The officer immediately informed the Empire of Sajar's presence, and as the officer expected, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] dispatched the [[Emperor's Wrath]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]&mdash;his personal enforcer&mdash;to Quesh in order to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the traitor.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial officer was first mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "The Emperor's Wrath" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />
